title: unified-rollouts-add-weighted-shadow-ab-autorollback-policy
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Add weighted-canary + shadow + A/B automatic rollback policy to unified rollouts. Improves safety for staged model rollouts and enables metric quorum and weight fallback behavior.
description:
Motivation: customers run multi-variant rollouts (canary + A/B + shadow) and need deterministic automatic rollback behavior when composite metrics degrade. This PR adds a first-class weighted-canary+shadow AB autorollback policy to the unified rollouts engine and exposes config knobs for metric quorums, weight decay, and emergency quarantine.

What's changed: implemented a new rollback policy class (WeightedShadowABPolicy) wired into the rollouts registry; extended rollout spec to accept `weights` and `shadow_percentage` per stage; added composite-metric evaluation with quorum rules and per-metric thresholds; added graceful weight-decay and automatic fallback to safe_variant on threshold breach; added telemetry (per-stage error_ratio, latency_p95, traffic_weight) and blocking alerts when quorum cannot be evaluated.

Compatibility: policy defaults to conservative behavior (0.0 shadow traffic until explicitly enabled). Existing rollout configurations are backward compatible: if `policy` is unspecified we keep previous behavior. The new policy is gated behind a feature flag `unified_rollouts.weighted_shadow_ab` to allow staged enablement for Dedicated clusters.

Testing & validation: unit tests for policy decisions and quorum calculations; integration tests that simulate synthetic metric streams and verify rollback, quarantine, and weight-decay semantics; e2e scenario that runs a 2-stage canary + shadow AB rollout with intentional latency regression to assert rollback triggers and observability events. Also ran perf microbenchmarks to verify decision path adds negligible latency to routing loop (~0.6ms median).

Rollout plan: merge to main behind feature flag -> enable in staging for smoke tests -> gradual enable in Dedicated with config set by Platform SRE. Monitoring: new dashboards added and alert rules created to watch metric quorum health during initial rollout.

Checklist:
- [x] Design doc updated and linked in Linear (ENG-1724)
- [x] Unit & integration tests added
- [x] E2E scenarios and canary runbook updated
- [x] Telemetry + dashboards added
- [x] Feature flag gating implemented

Related: ENG-1724 (policy design), ENG-1726 (observability), SUP-4128 (customer report prompting quarantine behavior).

merge_details: Merged by squash-merge after approvals (Rajiv, Sofia) and green CI. Merge commit includes changelog entry and feature-flag gating notes.
notes_for_ops: Feature flag `unified_rollouts.weighted_shadow_ab` must be enabled in release.yml per cluster. For Dedicated customers, Platform SRE will coordinate enabling and monitor `rollouts.quorum_unavailable` alerts. If unexpected rollbacks occur, set feature flag to false to stop new policy from being selected for new rollouts.
examples: helm values: enable flag in helm/values.rollouts.yaml under `featureFlags.unified_rollouts.weighted_shadow_ab: true`
